correctness.rationale: For a finite chain quotient, valuation layers have sizes \(s(q-1)q^{\ell-i-1}\) and adjacency is exactly the threshold \(i+j\ge\ell\). Their degrees are strictly increasing, making the layers intrinsic. The ordered class sizes recover \(\ell\), \(q\), and \(s=|I|\). Conversely those parameters determine the full threshold blow-up graph. The \(\ell=2\) collision is explicit.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete isomorphism classification for a standard algebraic graph family. It recovers an ideal-level parameter that the quotient graph alone cannot see, gives an intrinsic reconstruction from degree classes, and identifies the exact nilpotency-length boundary where separate recovery of residue order and ideal size fails.
